snippet.title: FOLLOW US | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Follow Us is a 2-player asymmetrical co-op horror game where communication is your only lifeline. One player explores dangerous and haunted locations in the field as EXY, while the other, OPY, guides them remotely from a surveillance van using cameras, lights, traps and security systems. Every level introduces new mechanics, fears and unexpected situations designed to create tension, panic and unforgettable co-op moments.

Wishlist Follow Us on Steam and join the community before the show begins: 
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014580/Follow_Us/
- Discord: https://discord.com/invite/DheRrXjba5
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
